description: Search, quicklook and measure Umbra's open SAR archive from any MCP client.

cmd.description: The server ships inside the umbra-py distribution and needs its [mcp] extra, so the package uvx installs is not the bare identifier.
cmd.name: --from

cmd.description: The console script to run from that distribution ([project.scripts] in pyproject.toml).

name: io.github.reesehammer/umbra-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Canopy API token. Set it and the same search tools query Umbra's authenticated commercial archive instead of the open bucket; leave it unset for the open data, which needs no credentials.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRA_CANOPY_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local catalog index (built with 'umbra index build' or fetched with 'umbra index fetch'). Without one the server walks the public bucket per search, which is correct but slow.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRA_INDEX_DB

environmentVariables.description: Enables the two opt-in model tools, describe_scene and narrate_change. Every other tool is deterministic and calls no model.
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Alternative provider for the same two model tools, and the encoder behind find_similar_text.
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

runtimeArguments.description: The server ships inside the umbra-py distribution and needs its [mcp] extra, so the package uvx installs is not the bare identifier.
runtimeArguments.name: --from

runtimeArguments.description: The console script to run from that distribution ([project.scripts] in pyproject.toml).

title: Umbra open SAR archive
